0.0: I came to this world long ago and I made Masteria my home... but I cannot help feeling lonely. You look like someone I can confide in. Will you be my friend?

1.0: Here, I will give you this belt as a symbol of our friendship. This is from the Versal, and I assure you, you will find no other like it.
